versions.changelog:
- Removed the obsolete version field from SKILL.md.
- No other content changes; documentation and workflow remain as before.
Update [[resume-screening]] cross-references to [[recruiting-resume-screening]] after slug rename.
Add homepage link to GitHub source repository (https://github.com/SoulZhong/recruiting-skills).

- Initial release of the jd-writing skill.
- Provides a comprehensive workflow for writing or revising Chinese-language job descriptions for any company, industry, or role.
- Emphasizes industry-standard job titles, candidate-facing language, and alignment with official business materials.
- Introduces quality self-checks, common pitfalls, and clear candidate-focused structure (job duties, requirements, plus, and opt-out).
- Includes feedback and update mechanisms to continuously improve job description quality.
